test_title: PYST 51: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56248d55de61d339c1d79d324f06a9b34e02b5819aa5c3102b8b4ff06345c80a.png] 

The logic followed here is based on the alphabetical position pattern:

Option 1: QPT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d9a3d5061ece152c963aea10d6d2ffc7562eb7ba11460a61c157d62baa6a885.png] 

Option 2: ORN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd90cae314927e7925989a609073b47b08d8171ab6ebaecb1c106de00a14bfc1.png] 

Option 3: KNJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9793f368a01a2b94c85151f0e008e25c7fd09e6e96157b49f30e324a430fc69.png] 

Option 4: FIE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f942e9992af970df1d29d2c4eebef865e1de060c228127c9f3201dedcc6aea6.png] 

Thus, ORN, KNJ and FIE follow the same (+3, −4) positional pattern, while QPT follows a different pattern.

Hence, the odd one out is **Option 1.**
